details.description: Moonshot-v1-128k-vision-preview was a preview vision variant of Moonshot AI's moonshot-v1-128k chat model, adding image input on top of the same 128,000-token context window, accepting images through the standard OpenAI-style content array with image_url blocks. Moonshot AI's current platform documentation states the moonshot-v1 series, including its vision-preview variants, was officially discontinued on August 31, 2026 and is no longer maintained or supported, with users directed to Kimi K3 instead.
advantages: Added image input on top of moonshot-v1-128k's 128,000-token context window, accepting images via the standard OpenAI-style image_url content blocks, per LiteLLM's provider documentation.
disadvantages: Officially discontinued on August 31, 2026 and no longer maintained or supported, per Moonshot AI's current platform documentation.
Was a preview release, per its model name, rather than a generally-available vision model.
Moonshot AI directs users to migrate to the newer Kimi K3 model, which has native visual understanding, for continued support.
use_cases: Was used for image-input chat completion via Moonshot AI's OpenAI-compatible API

notes: Moonshot AI has removed this model's own docs/model-card page since discontinuing it, so no maker page describes its original feature set beyond context length and image support; website_url left null. Catalog facts list no deprecation_date, but Moonshot AI's model list page explicitly states the vision-preview variants of moonshot-v1 (including this model) were discontinued 2026-08-31, which is worth reflecting in the catalog's deprecation_date.
